claim: JC Solutions transitioned over a dozen projects in the last three years.
The conversion rate for qualified employees receiving job offers was 90%.
The transition process has six steps.
Jacobs has more than 40 years of transition experience and has welcomed over 10,000 new employees.
Kelly Irving brings more than 30 years of experience and led a transition serving 13 communities and approximately 50 employees under a 20-year contract.
Full transition and integration occurs over 90 days from the start date.
The long-term transition phase spans 12 months from the start date.
Exit transition activities begin no later than nine months before the end of the O&M term.
JC Solutions may provide up to 180 days of extended support post-exit.
The Exit Transition Plan will be developed within 90 days of commencement.
Compliance audit and regulatory reporting support each extend for 30 days.
Tools, spare parts, and consumables are stocked for at least four weeks post-handover.
